name: Vigil Reliquary

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The reliquary makes two Censer attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *Guiding Bolt*.

Actions.name: Censer
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The reliquary casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** *Guiding Bolt*, *Light*, *Detect Magic*
- **1/Day Each:** *Blight* (level 6 version)

Bonus Actions.name: Relic's Blessing (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The reliquary touches a creature within 5 feet of itself and restores 45 (13d6) Hit Points to it.

Traits.name: Warded Mending
Traits.text: The reliquary regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point and its ward is within 30 feet of it.

lore: A saint's bones sealed in iron were never laid to rest, and the shrine's unending vigil taught the metal to judge, so it now walks the world deciding who deserves the saint's mercy.

generation.userConcept: a saint's reliquary that heals what is loyal and withers what is not
generation.cite: composition after Deva (CR 10) — two radiant-rider strikes on an armored chassis

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a saint's reliquary that heals what is loyal and withers what is not
